reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual third-round review of external-03 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 07 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution profile/hair crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

entries.positive_observation: External-03 restores the dark profile-side eyebrow and retains short dark temple/nape hair on the yellow mascot. The distinctive near-profile still faces and gazes viewer left, with the far eye reduced to a narrow exposure and one firm closed mouth; no glasses or beard were added. The dark olive cap retains gold crown piping/front decoration and the bright pale visor reflection. Red/gold collar details, a prominent gold viewer-left shoulder board and a pale/red ribbon with a silver-toned detail remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or clipping. The note has exactly two compact upper gray-mark rows with two groups per row, no third row or lower-left dash, and largely blank lower paper. The complete dark tilted frame, darker opaque gray-olive backing, cream note and right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: The narrow upper-lip detail, exact cap/neck insignia and finest temple/nape hair edge are not fully readable at source scale. These fine uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the restored dark eyebrow, near-profile pose and two-row note layout are directly visible.
